description:
Keystone of the native re-green (split out of fz-go4.18.3 after investigation proved the 8 failures span TWO independent convergence loci).

SCOPE
Source a delivered resume payload's STRUCTURAL transport shape from the producer (the callee's settled ExecutableReturn ABI), not from the consumer's oscillating value-demand. In project_one_executable's resume branch (transport.rs ~1970-2006), dispatch on the RuntimeDemand axes:
- data return (!demand.is_callable()): union the resume position with the callee ExecutableReturn position (shape_graph.equal) — the producer-sourced anchoring the old is_ignore branch used, now generalized. A field this caller ignores is never erased to Nothing, because a TupleFields callee physically delivers every field regardless of the caller's [Whole,Ignore]<->[Whole,Whole] demand oscillation. Subsumes the old is_ignore special case.
- callable return (demand.is_callable()): keep the demand-driven resume_shape projection UNCHANGED — this is the direct-vs-first-class boundary selection the other tests assert. A callable return carries an empty data shape, so the axes never overlap; boundary selection is byte-for-byte unchanged.

SIGNAL
- Greens (deterministically, across repeated/ schedule-varied full runs): compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_enum_map_reduce_with_direct_closure_targets and compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi.
- Adds compiler2_native_program_resume_payload_shape_is_schedule_independent: drives 00001_quicksort_plus_foo.fz 3x under varying wake order, asserts partition/4's tuple-field continuation stays structurally complete (extra_params==2, exactly one) every drive, observed via native_program telemetry. Fails pre-keystone, passes post.
- No regression; callable-boundary selection behavior unchanged. cargo test --lib compiler2 = 931 passed / 6 failed, STABLE across 3 fresh runs (the 6 are the residual input-merge/membership locus -> fz-go4.18.3.2). clippy -D warnings = 0; fmt clean.

GUARDRAILS MET
No legacy seal/transport revival; no test weakening; correct-by-construction (physical shape owned by producer ABI; consumer demand may narrow representation, never erase delivered structure).
title: Keystone: source delivered resume-payload shape from callee ExecutableReturn ABI
